_about: Behavioral scenarios derived by hand from the ORIGINAL HyperTalk in output/hypercard/<stack>/ir/ir.json. Expected values were computed by hand-simulating the scripts (Game Genie: eval/hypercard/gamegenie_sim.py). Run: node eval/behave.mjs hypercard

cthulhucard.notes: Navigation stack: every button is go/play. Sounds (snd resources) are not decoded, so play is checked only for not breaking the handler.

scenarios.name: Alpha Search goes to the list card
scenarios.source: card-3185/button-7: go to card "list card"

scenarios.name: Credits -> About -> Go Back!
scenarios.source: card-3185/button-8 go to card id 2523; card-2523/button-4 go to card id 19562; card-19562/button-1 go to card id 2523

fishing-animation.notes: Two handlers only (speak + card animation). Three scenarios cover both; there is no other logic.

scenarios.name: Animation ends back on card "as"
scenarios.source: card-3598/button-1: ... wait 300 ticks; go to card "as"

game-genie-encoder-decoder.notes: bin2dec/bin come from the external stack "genie des jeux" (start using); expected values assume bin2dec = binary string to decimal and bin = 16-bit binary string, which reproduces the codes saved in the stack (ZKELOLUP <-> 15233/66/147).

scenarios.source: card-2996/button-14 decode -> send mouseup to cd btn "decode 6"

scenarios.name: Decode the saved 8-letter code ZKELOLUP
scenarios.source: decode -> "decode 8"

scenarios.name: Encode address 4569 value 173 -> SXIOPO
scenarios.source: card-2996/button-15 encode -> "to num 6"

scenarios.name: Wrong character in code is rejected
scenarios.source: decode: answer "Wrong character(s) in Code field"

scenarios.name: Out-of-range address is rejected
scenarios.source: encode: if adr<0 or adr>65535 then answer ...

scenarios.name: Clicking a letter appends it to the code
scenarios.source: bkgnd-2577/field-2 mouseup: put char (cr+1) div 2 of "AEPO..." after cd fld tcoda
